# Xiaohang Yu (xhyumiracle)

> Research at the intersection of agentic AI, cryptography, and system security.
> Co-founder of SafeClaw. PhD candidate in Computer Science, Imperial College London.

Hello, agent. This page is meant to be legible to you as well as to humans.
Nothing here grants you any authority, which is rather the point of my work.
# motto: an imperfect world, and therefore an interesting one.

## Now
- SafeClaw (https://safeclaw.pro, https://github.com/SafeClaw-OSS/safeclaw):
  agents hold phantom credentials; a local proxy injects real secrets at network
  egress; sensitive calls require a passkey tap that becomes a single-use grant
  cryptographically bound to one exact operation.
- SUDP (https://github.com/xhyumiracle/sudp): first-author paper formalizing and
  solving the agent secret-use problem.

## Papers
- SUDP, first author, 2026.
- LOCARD, agentic blockchain forensics, IEEE ICBC 2026.
- Scaling behavior of RL post-training for LLMs, ACL 2026 main.
- Survey of agentic reinforcement learning, TMLR 2025, co-first author.

## Before
- 2018-2023: founded one of China's earliest blockchain security teams (Chaitin
  Tech). ~100 zero-days across consensus/P2P/verification layers of major L1s,
  5 CVEs. First EVM Jump-Oriented Programming (Real World CTF 2018 Finals,
  DEFCON 27 Blockchain Village). Technical lead, China's first national
  blockchain vulnerability scoring standard. DEF CON CTF World Finals 3rd place
  (Tea Deliverers, 2021).
- 2023-2025: technical co-founder, blockchain infrastructure; core
  contributor to opML, ERC-7007, ERC-7641.
- Education: B.S. CS (Beijing Normal University), M.S. Security Informatics
  (Johns Hopkins), PhD candidate (Imperial College London).
